title: Mourning
summary: Wang Zhuo and Wang Hao come home to a celebration in the Wang family village, where the family still waits for Tie Zhu. Teng Huayuan arrives with Gao Qiming, finds the village through Wang Lin's blood ties, and starts slaughtering the Wang clan. Wang Lin appears and shouts that he alone killed Teng Li, but he cannot stop the old monster. Before his eyes his father and mother die, refusing to crush the jade bead that would call him back into danger, and Teng Huayuan seals their souls in a Soul Flag, giving Wang Lin three months to come to Cassia Valley. Wang Zhuo and Wang Hao are spared at Pu Nanzi's request. In his grief Wang Lin breaks a bottleneck into the Extreme Realm, which makes him the strongest at his level but caps him at Nascent Soul. Situ Nan says the souls in the flag can one day be revived, and Wang Lin enters Cassia Valley to seize all seven tokens, learning from a captive that Liu Mei holds the last one.
